author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PowerMean v3 — Reverse-Aug + Bi-Reverse Eval, α=0.5, AdamW(0.85,0.99), clip=0.75
abstract: Adds training-time reverse augmentation and evaluation-time bi-directional averaging to a compact DSConv + power-mean model, with mild residual scaling (α=0.5) for stability and AdamW(b1=0.85,b2=0.99, clip=0.75). Architecture remains dataset-agnostic.
